features.text: BEND-TO-FIT TECHNOLOGY: Allows manual shaping of the brace for precise elbow positioning.
THERAPEUTIC EXTENSION SUPPORT: Promotes progressive stretching for contracture relief.
LIGHTWEIGHT COMFORT: Soft materials allow all-day wear during recovery or therapy.
UNIVERSAL FIT: Adjustable design accommodates both left and right arms.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.

indications: Mild to severe contractures of the elbow
